scope: Current fixed-reference valuation core only. No historical full-macro allocation is claimed.
decision_rule: 1st of each calendar month; most recent NIFTY observation strictly before that date, age <=7 days.
yield_rule: Two calendar-month lag; RBI archived SGL tenor yields before OECD coverage, then OECD monthly long-term yields. Series definitions differ. Publication times and historical vintages are not verified.
threshold_rule: Strictly greater than 80%, based on unrounded allocations. Debt >80% means equity <20%.
